uee.set.fields.only: only these fields: %s (identity fields are always kept)
uee.set.tags.only: only elements tagged %s (untagged elements are excluded)
uee.set.maxFile.none: no byte-based file limit; shards split by record count
uee.set.maxFile.limit: shards split at about %s MiB (a whole record may overshoot)
uee.set.dryRun: dry run: nothing will be written, but the plan is real
uee.set.assets.on: assets: textures, models, sounds and language files will be copied
uee.set.delta.on: delta: only what changed since the last run will be written
uee.set.autoRun.on: auto-run: an export will run when a game starts
uee.set.persist.none: nothing will be kept between runs
uee.set.userDir.default: state directory: back to the default
uee.err.badShards: /uee set shards <records>, where records is at least 1
uee.err.badMaxFile: /uee set max-file-mb <n>, where n is 0 or more
uee.err.languageUnknown: no messages are shipped in '%s'; available: %s
uee.err.settingMustCarryLayer: a setting must carry a layer
